productPageCtaAndListingStatus.detail: All 3 new-to-market references were checked on their exact DE product pages; all showed direct purchase and are listed. L4.523.0.50.2, which resolved the source mismatch, was also rechecked and remained listed at the unchanged €3,950 price. Existing market rows were not individually audited. Notify-me maps to listed per user instruction. Follow-up: No existing exact product page CTA check was completed for this market. Per-reference listing signals are separately recorded in data/evidence/longines/DE/2026-10-12/observations.json#/supplementalEvidence/existingCtaRecheck and are not represented as direct product-page CTA checks. Follow-up completed through 2026-10-13: attempted 804 references, confirmed 799 exact product pages at least once, could not reach 5 exact pages after retries, and left 3 confirmed-page CTA(s) unresolved. Full records: observations.json#/supplementalEvidence/existingProductPageCtaChecks.

independentOfficialSpotCheck.detail: The complete rendered All Watches listing was independently re-collected, and exact official pages were checked for 3 new references plus the one reappearing existing reference. The broad 19–21 representative sample of unchanged entries was not conducted. Follow-up: 2 absent-old-reference URLs were attempted; 2 redirected to market home, so no product-page CTA was inspected.

strictJsonAndSchema.detail: Strict JSON parsing rejected duplicate keys and invalid constants. Catalog/market/history instances validated against local schemas using the repository-pinned Ajv 6.15 compiler; the Draft 2020-12 metaschema URI was removed because this engine does not implement that metaschema, while local constraints, formats, references, and conditional rules compiled and passed.

formalWriteValidation.detail: Cross-brand validator passed all 43 market files. DE all-watches UI collection reconciles to 804 unique references; source refs and prices reconcile; old market row objects were preserved; all old price series remain prefixes; only three evidence-backed additions and three not-listed points were appended; schemas and protected markets were unchanged.

limitations: The broad independent 19–21 representative sample of unchanged products was not run.
The formal market watchCount is 807 because 3 older references absent from the complete source remain in the market data with not-listed history points.
Evidence records observation date only; exact per-request timestamps were not retained.

Existing product-page CTA audit attempted all 804 references through 2026-10-13: 799 exact product pages were confirmed at least once, 5 could not reach an exact product page after retries, and 3 confirmed pages had unresolved purchase CTA. Full attempts are in observations.json supplementalEvidence.

2 representative absent-old-reference URLs redirect to the localized market home; together with absence from the complete market listing this supports market-specific not-listed, not global discontinuation.
